methodology: Availability is applied by week to the starter and backup quarterback components. Unlisted teams default to full starter availability.

statusRules.major-knee-recovery-in-team-drills: 85% in Week 1, improving as full-team work continues, then 100% from Week 4.

KC.note: Patrick Mahomes has progressed to repeated 11-on-11 work in training camp, but the model retains a modest early-season recovery discount until regular-season clearance.
